gun.ar.near.notes: m4a1-class. Firework crack + soft-clipped 200 Hz thump + 620 Hz cartoon thock. Round-robin at random; ±3% rate on top of the baked variation.

gun.ak.near.notes: ak47-class. Same recipe pitched down ~10%, longer body and tail — reads heavier and slower than the AR.

gun.smg.near.notes: SMG. Cracks pitched up ~45%, short thump; built to stack at 900 RPM without smearing.

gun.sniper.near.notes: m40a3-class. Big bang core + cannon body at 0.72x + a 1.4 s muffled tail. Loudest asset in the pack.

gun.ar.far.notes: Other players' AR: -7.5 dB vs near, 11 kHz lowpass, 2-5 kHz pulled 9 dB, soft transient and a 1.1 s reverb tail. Designed to be pleasant when 20 of these overlap.

gun.smg.far.notes: Distant SMG — light, quick, mostly tail.

gun.sniper.far.notes: Distant sniper — the crack-then-roll silhouette that carries across the map.

reload.out.notes: Stage 1/3: latch pop + plastic banana-mag shuffle + soft drop thump. Shared by all classes; pitch by class (sniper 0.9x, smg 1.1x).

reload.in.notes: Stage 2/3: mag seats — plastic shuffle into a metal clack with a wood-thunk body.

reload.rack.notes: Stage 3/3: charging handle. File 1 = ar/ak/smg, file 2 = sniper bolt (0.82x rack, heavier).

footstep.dirt.notes: Walk takes; run = same files at 1.15-1.25x rate and +2 dB. Gravel/mud/leaf/grass blends, each with a 260 Hz soft body.

footstep.metal.notes: Thimras metal takes 01/07/13/20 + tin sweetener + low thud; 3.3 kHz notched so a sprint on deck plate never rings.

hit.marker.notes: 90 ms tick+thock+pluck. Quiet by design (-7 dBFS) — it fires many times per second.

hit.kill.notes: The dopamine hit: marimba-ish major arpeggio (root/3rd/5th) over a low punch, 0.6 s reverb. Distinct from hitmarker in length, pitch content and stereo width.

hit.headshot.notes: Kill confirm + octave top note + a filtered bell ding — same family, obviously 'better'.

hit.damage_taken.notes: Dull body thud: soft impact lowpassed at 1.5 kHz over a 150 Hz cannon sub. No high content, so taking fire never stings.

grenade.pin.notes: Metal click + latch + a tiny spring twang for the toon read.

grenade.throw.notes: Heavy swish at 0.8x plus a rubbery boing tail.

grenade.bounce.notes: Casino dice/chip clatter + spring + soft low hop. Alternate the two and let pitch vary widely — it is the most repeated grenade sound.

grenade.explode.near.notes: Cannon body at 0.74x, sub layer, crunch debris and a 1.6 s muffled roll. The pack's loudest, fattest asset.

grenade.explode.far.notes: Off-screen version: 2.6 kHz lowpass, 1.8 s reverb, -8 dBFS.

medal.streak.notes: Escalating steel-drum family: same jingle at 1.0 / 1.122 / 1.26 / 1.498x (unison, +2, +4, +7 semitones) so consecutive medals are consonant with each other. Index by streak count.

medal.banner.notes: Big banner moment: steel jingle + a fifth-up answer + coin shimmer over a soft boom.

ui.click.notes: Menu tick — 60 ms, -9 dBFS, no energy above 12 kHz.

ui.deploy.notes: Confirm blip + rising fifth + low whump. Same harmonic world as the medals.

ui.match_start.notes: Riser into steel-drum fanfare with a monkey hoot answering — the game's signature.

ui.match_end.notes: MASHED! — squishy banana splat over a boom, then the long steel jingle.

ambience.jungle_loop.notes: 46 s seamless stereo bed: forest birds + cicadas + a panned single cicada, crossfade-wrapped (4 s / 2 s / 4 s). Loop it raw — do NOT fade the ends.

ambience.accent.bird.notes: Sparse one-shots; fire every 8-25 s at random 3D positions.
